title.zh: 把私有工作流直接转化为公开内容资产
title.en: Turning Private Workflows into Public Content Assets

old_assumption.zh: 做内容必须专门抽出额外时间“憋选题、写长文、剪视频”。
old_assumption.en: Creating content requires carving out separate time to brainstorm topics, write essays, or film videos.

new_shift.zh: 在 AI 垃圾文章泛滥的时代，把你日常解决问题沉淀下来的结构化清单、分类库、Prompt 和工具直接开源展示，才是最具传播力的硬通货。
new_shift.en: In a sea of AI slop, publishing the real checklists, taxonomies, prompts, and mini-tools you already built for yourself earns far higher trust and shares.

zh: 我平时在工作/生活中反复做的一件事是：[描述你的具体事情]。请帮我把它拆解成一个可复用的公开资产（模板/静态卡片库/清单），并设计 3 个能让同行主动转发的切入点。
如何把 [你的某个日常研究/踩坑记录] 改造成一个可交互、可搜索的极简网页合集，让它从一次性文章变成长期带来自然流量的资产？
en: I repeatedly do [Specific Task] in my work/life. Help me package this process into a reusable public asset (template, checklist, or static library) with 3 angles peers will actually share.
How can I turn my raw notes on [Your Topic] into a searchable, interactive mini-site that compounds organic traffic instead of dying in a social feed?

note.zh: 将个人高频 AI 工作流与提示词沉淀为可检索的公开卡片库
note.en: Personal AI workflows packaged as a searchable public card library

title.zh: 反算法推荐的“交互式网页玩具”内容

old_assumption.zh: 传播观点和获取流量只能靠图文、短视频和播客去卷平台算法。
old_assumption.en: Spreading ideas and earning attention means fighting social algorithms with text threads or short videos.

new_shift.zh: AI 让单人做出精巧的交互式小网页门槛骤降，一个能让用户亲手点 3 分钟的“可玩概念”，传播穿透力远超一万字长文。
new_shift.en: AI collapsed the cost of interactive frontends—a 3-minute playable web toy or simulator spreads organically far better than a 3,000-word essay.

zh: 我想向大众解释一个复杂概念：[填入你想讲的概念]。请帮我设计 3 个“可交互网页玩具/小游戏”的玩法原型，让用户玩 2 分钟就能彻底悟懂。
针对 [你的目标受众，如程序员/理财新手/英语学习者]，设计一个带有反差幽默感、用户玩完会忍不住截图发朋友圈的极简网页小测试。
en: I want to explain [Complex Concept] intuitively. Propose 3 interactive web-toy or mini-simulator mechanics that let users grasp it by playing for 2 minutes.
For [Target Audience], design a playful, slightly absurd single-page web interactive whose result screen naturally makes people share screenshots.

note.zh: 独立开发者靠一系列脑洞网页小玩具持续获得亿级自然传播
note.en: Indie creator driving hundreds of millions of organic visits through pure web toys

note.zh: 用交互式模拟取代静态文章的“可探索式解释”合集
note.en: Curated hub of interactive essays and playable simulations

title.zh: 极高密度的“反过载策展”替代泛资讯搬运
title.en: High-Density Anti-Slop Curation Over Volume Publishing

old_assumption.zh: 做自媒体必须保持日更、追热点，靠更新频率维持存在感。
old_assumption.en: Creators must post daily and chase trending news to stay relevant.

new_shift.zh: 内容供给无限趋近于免费后，受众最稀缺的不是“多看一篇”，而是有人替他们狠心删掉 99% 噪音、只留 1% 经过实测验证的精选。
new_shift.en: When content volume is infinite and free, audiences don't want more posts—they pay attention to curators who ruthlessly delete 99% of the noise.

zh: 在 [你关注的垂直领域] 里，大家每天都被哪些低质重复信息轰炸？帮我设计一份“每月只发一次、但每条都经过实测验证”的高密度策展专栏结构。
如何为 [某垂直主题] 设计一套透明的“入选红线与淘汰标准”，让读者一眼看出我的推荐库和普通搬运号有本质区别？
en: What repetitive noise floods [Your Niche] every week? Design a low-frequency, ultra-high-density curation format where every item is hands-on verified.
Draft a transparent 'inclusion & rejection rubric' for a curated library on [Your Topic] so readers immediately trust its signal-to-noise ratio.

note.zh: 独立策展周刊，靠极高的审美与信息密度积累了忠实全球读者
note.en: Independent curated newsletter thriving on taste and signal density
